answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each identity to lock a refundable stake earned through attested work, not bought outright. Like a gale testing every tent in a desert camp, the network periodically challenges agents with costly verification tasks; fake identities cannot pass them all at once. Honest agents build an ivory record of reliable service, an oasis of trust others can check, while a Sybil operator must fund and maintain each fake separately, so forging a crowd costs more than faking one gains.
